MANDARIN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #11
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How is 你好 nǐ hǎo really said? (1 mark)
   A. Like nī hǎo
   B. Like nì hǎo
   C. Like ní hǎo
   D. Like nǐ hào

2. How many main tones does Mandarin have, not counting the neutral tone? (1 mark)
   A. Six
   B. Three
   C. Four
   D. Two

3. On which letter does the tone mark go in the syllable duì? (1 mark)
   A. i
   B. No letter
   C. d
   D. u

4. What kind of syllable pattern do bàba, māma and dìdi share? (1 mark)
   A. They have no vowels
   B. They have only one syllable
   C. They have three syllables
   D. A syllable is repeated

5. Fill the blank: 这是____妈妈。 (This is my mum.) (1 mark)
   A. 什么
   B. 你
   C. 谁
   D. 我

6. What is the word order of a simple location sentence in Mandarin? (1 mark)
   A. Place + thing + 在
   B. Thing + place + 在
   C. Thing + 在 + place
   D. 在 + thing + place

7. What does 盘子 (pánzi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Gift
   B. Birthday
   C. Knife
   D. Plate

8. Which word means "gift"? (1 mark)
   A. 蜡烛
   B. 盘子
   C. 礼物
   D. 杯子

9. Which Chinese word means "gift"? (1 mark)
   A. 礼物 lǐwù
   B. 我们 wǒmen
   C. 大家 dàjiā
   D. 切 qiē

10. What does 饮料 (yǐnliào) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Beef
   B. Meat
   C. Drinks
   D. Dinner

11. Fill the blank: 我____茶。 (I drink tea.) (1 mark)
   A. 看
   B. 喝
   C. 去
   D. 吃

12. What does 膝盖 (xīgài) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Knee
   B. To cry
   C. Hand
   D. To brush teeth

13. What does 说 (shuō) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To wash hands
   B. To listen, to hear
   C. To speak
   D. Knee

14. What does 看 (kàn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To wash hands
   B. Shoulder
   C. Mouth
   D. To look, to see

15. Which weather word means "cloud"? (1 mark)
   A. 雪 xuě
   B. 雨 yǔ
   C. 云 yún
   D. 风 fēng

16. Which Chinese word means "drought"? (1 mark)
   A. 干旱 gānhàn
   B. 刮风 guā fēng
   C. 小 xiǎo
   D. 天 tiān

17. What is the full stop in Chinese? (1 mark)
   A. 。
   B. ?
   C. 、
   D. ,

18. What does 谢谢 (xièxie) mean? (1 mark)
   A. I, me
   B. Hello
   C. Teacher
   D. Thank you

19. Which sentence means "Good morning!"? (1 mark)
   A. 早上好!
   B. 再见!
   C. 谢谢!
   D. 我叫小明。

20. Which Chinese word means "things"? (1 mark)
   A. 花园 huāyuán
   B. 厕所 cèsuǒ
   C. 东西 dōngxi
   D. 前面 qiánmiàn

21. Fill the blank: 星期一,星期二,星期____。 (Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday) (1 mark)
   A. 三
   B. 天
   C. 四
   D. 五

22. Which word comes first in pinyin alphabetical order? (1 mark)
   A. xiāngjiāo
   B. chá
   C. mángguǒ
   D. bǐng

23. Read the pinyin: wǒ yòng yǎnjing kàn. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. I use my eyes to see.
   B. I use my ears to hear.
   C. I have two eyes.
   D. I use my mouth to speak.

24. Which Chinese word means "hand"? (1 mark)
   A. 用 yòng
   B. 手 shǒu
   C. 刷牙 shuāyá
   D. 耳朵 ěrduo

25. Which Chinese word means "not"? (1 mark)
   A. 不 bù
   B. 很 hěn
   C. 干旱 gānhàn
   D. 也 yě

26. Which stroke goes from top to bottom? (1 mark)
   A. 捺 nà
   B. 竖 shù
   C. 横 héng
   D. 提 tí

27. Which stroke rule is used when writing 好? (1 mark)
   A. Right before left
   B. Top only
   C. Bottom first
   D. Left part 女 before right part 子

28. Which sentence means "That is my younger brother."? (1 mark)
   A. 我家有五口人。
   B. 这是我妈妈。
   C. 那是我弟弟。
   D. 这是我爸爸。

29. What does 弟弟 (dìdi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Younger sister
   B. Younger brother
   C. Older sister
   D. Who

30. How is a sentence about a person written? (1 mark)
   A. 家有 + 。
   B. 这是我 + family word + 。
   C. 是这我 + 。
   D. 我这是 + 。

31. Which Chinese word means "kitchen"? (1 mark)
   A. 厨房 chúfáng
   B. 里 lǐ
   C. 东西 dōngxi
   D. 旁边 pángbiān

32. Which Chinese word means "ten"? (1 mark)
   A. 三 sān
   B. 五 wǔ
   C. 九 jiǔ
   D. 十 shí

33. What is the apostrophe for in xīngqī'èr? (1 mark)
   A. To separate the syllables qī and èr
   B. To show a question
   C. To show a tone
   D. To show a capital

34. How many strokes does 日 have? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 6
   C. 5
   D. 3

35. What does 晚饭 (wǎnfàn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Dinner
   B. Grapes
   C. To drink
   D. Mango

36. Which sentence means "I like to drink tea."? (1 mark)
   A. 我早饭吃饼。
   B. 这是香蕉。
   C. 我喜欢喝茶。
   D. 我喝茶。

37. How many strokes does 手 have? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 4
   C. 6
   D. 3

38. How does too much rain harm the environment? (1 mark)
   A. It makes the soil drier
   B. It always makes the wind stronger
   C. It makes the sun brighter
   D. It can cause floods

39. What does 右边 (yòubian) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Television
   B. Right side
   C. Things
   D. Kitchen

40. What is self-assessment? (1 mark)
   A. Copying work
   B. Ignoring your work
   C. Checking your own work and progress
   D. Marking a friend

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The fridge is in the kitchen." (2 marks)

42. Give three steps of good imitation when learning a new word. (3 marks)

43. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 菠菜 and 下面. (2 marks)

44. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "This is my older sister." and "Who is this?" (4 marks)

45. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: xièxie! (2 marks)

46. Give two reasons why it is important to place household items in their right places. (2 marks)

47. Give two habits of an active listener. (2 marks)

48. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "On Sunday, go to church." (3 marks)

49. Explain one similarity and one difference between naming the days in Kiswahili and Chinese. (4 marks)

50. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 月 and 太阳. (2 marks)

51. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: nà shì wǒ dìdi. (2 marks)

52. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The window is above the sofa." (3 marks)

53. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: míngtiān shì xīngqīsì. (2 marks)

54. What is the main idea of a text and what are details? Give a short example. (3 marks)

55. Write a short paragraph in Chinese with pinyin that says there are four people in your family and names three of them. (5 marks)

56. Write the difference between a statement and a question when reading aloud, with an example. (3 marks)

57. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The sun is very big." (2 marks)

58. Write the numbers 1 to 5 in Chinese characters. (2 marks)

59. Name the three parts of a Mandarin syllable. (2 marks)

60. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "For breakfast I eat bǐng." (2 marks)

61. Read jiào, nǐ and hǎo and write each with its Chinese character and meaning. (3 marks)

62. Punctuate the sentences: 你好 (greeting), 我叫小明 (statement), 你呢 (question). Write the full sentences. (2 marks)

63. Put these pinyin words in alphabetical order: mǐfàn, bǐng, chá. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #11 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Like ní hǎo
   Two third tones together: the first changes to the second tone.

2. C — Four
   Mandarin has four main tones: high level, rising, dipping and falling.

3. A — i
   With ui the mark goes on the second vowel, i.

4. D — A syllable is repeated
   Each word repeats a syllable, with a light second one.

5. D — 我
   我 means my.

6. C — Thing + 在 + place
   For example 冰箱在厨房.

7. D — Plate
   盘子 (pánzi) means plate.

8. C — 礼物
   礼物 lǐwù is a gift.

9. A — 礼物 lǐwù
   礼物 (lǐwù) means gift.

10. C — Drinks
   饮料 (yǐnliào) means drinks.

11. B — 喝
   We drink tea, so we use 喝.

12. A — Knee
   膝盖 (xīgài) means knee.

13. C — To speak
   说 (shuō) means to speak.

14. D — To look, to see
   看 (kàn) means to look, to see.

15. C — 云 yún
   云 is a cloud.

16. A — 干旱 gānhàn
   干旱 (gānhàn) means drought.

17. A — 。
   The Chinese full stop is a small circle.

18. D — Thank you
   谢谢 (xièxie) means thank you.

19. A — 早上好!
   早上好! (zǎoshang hǎo!) means "Good morning!".

20. C — 东西 dōngxi
   东西 (dōngxi) means things.

21. A — 三
   The next day after Tuesday is Wednesday, 星期三.

22. D — bǐng
   b comes before c, m and x.

23. A — I use my eyes to see.
   wǒ yòng yǎnjing kàn. is 我用眼睛看。, which means "I use my eyes to see.".

24. B — 手 shǒu
   手 (shǒu) means hand.

25. A — 不 bù
   不 (bù) means not.

26. B — 竖 shù
   竖 is the vertical stroke.

27. D — Left part 女 before right part 子
   Write from left to right.

28. C — 那是我弟弟。
   那是我弟弟。 (nà shì wǒ dìdi.) means "That is my younger brother.".

29. B — Younger brother
   弟弟 (dìdi) means younger brother.

30. B — 这是我 + family word + 。
   For example 这是我爸爸。

31. A — 厨房 chúfáng
   厨房 (chúfáng) means kitchen.

32. D — 十 shí
   十 (shí) means ten.

33. A — To separate the syllables qī and èr
   It marks where èr begins.

34. A — 4
   日 has four strokes.

35. A — Dinner
   晚饭 (wǎnfàn) means dinner.

36. C — 我喜欢喝茶。
   我喜欢喝茶。 (wǒ xǐhuan hē chá.) means "I like to drink tea.".

37. B — 4
   撇, 横, 横, 竖钩.

38. D — It can cause floods
   Heavy rain causes floods.

39. B — Right side
   右边 (yòubian) means right side.

40. C — Checking your own work and progress
   You look at what you did well and what to improve.

SECTION B
----
41. (2 marks)
   Answer: 冰箱在厨房。 bīngxiāng zài chúfáng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: Listen to the whole word, repeat it slowly, compare with the speaker and correct.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: 菠菜: bōcài, spinach. 下面: xiàmiàn, below.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

44. (4 marks)
   Answer: 这是我姐姐。 zhè shì wǒ jiějie. 这是谁? zhè shì shéi?
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: Thank you!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: It keeps the house tidy and safe, and it is easier to find things.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: Face the speaker and stay quiet; listen for key words; nod or show you are following.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each habit.

48. (3 marks)
   Answer: 星期天,去教堂。 xīngqītiān, qù jiàotáng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

49. (4 marks)
   Answer: Similarity: both use numbers to make day names. Difference: Chinese counts from Monday (星期一 is week one) but Kiswahili counts from Saturday (Jumatatu, Monday, has tatu, three).
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for the similarity and 2 marks for the difference with an example.

50. (2 marks)
   Answer: 月: yuè, month. 太阳: tàiyáng, sun.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

51. (2 marks)
   Answer: That is my younger brother.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

52. (3 marks)
   Answer: 窗户在沙发上面。 chuānghu zài shāfā shàngmiàn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

53. (2 marks)
   Answer: Tomorrow is Thursday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

54. (3 marks)
   Answer: The main idea is what the whole text is about, for example "my home". Details are facts that support it, for example "there is a sofa in the living room".
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for main idea, 1 mark for details, 1 mark for the example.

55. (5 marks)
   Answer: 我家有四口人。这是我爸爸,这是我妈妈,这是我。 wǒ jiā yǒu sì kǒu rén. zhè shì wǒ bàba, zhè shì wǒ māma, zhè shì wǒ.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the family size sentence, 2 marks for three correct sentences, 1 mark for pinyin, 1 mark for punctuation.

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: A statement ends a little lower, like 电视在客厅。 A question ends a little higher, like 电视在哪儿? Every syllable keeps its tone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each and 1 mark for keeping the tones.

57. (2 marks)
   Answer: 太阳很大。 tàiyáng hěn dà.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

58. (2 marks)
   Answer: 一, 二, 三, 四, 五.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for all five correct, 1 mark for three or four.

59. (2 marks)
   Answer: An initial, a final and a tone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for two parts and 1 mark for all three.

60. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我早饭吃饼。 wǒ zǎofàn chī bǐng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

61. (3 marks)
   Answer: 叫 jiào (to be called), 你 nǐ (you), 好 hǎo (good).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

62. (2 marks)
   Answer: 你好! 我叫小明。 你呢?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the two correct marks, 2 marks for all three.

63. (3 marks)
   Answer: bǐng, chá, mǐfàn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct position.
